status: ADOPTED: single-arm PALM PRESS with the tip on the plate and the pipette uprighted by rotating the hand about the tip. 3/3 certified on its first run (21.5-22.8 mm, dispense sustained 110-132 steps, 30-34 chunks). The bimanual variants were abandoned (below).

mechanisms_tried.name: thumb yaw sweep in the air
mechanisms_tried.result: 24.5 mm once (probe), then 0/40 across curl, seating and wrist variants: the thumb lands at a fixed hand-frame point while the rod top varies 5 cm along the hand axis between replays

mechanisms_tried.name: palm press with the tip on the plate (single hand)
mechanisms_tried.result: the hand slides 10 cm down the barrel; the press creeps to 10-19 mm and plateaus unless the pipette happens to hang near vertical; uprighting by translation slides the tip off the plate; ~25 % of attempts

mechanisms_tried.name: thumb over the rod during the plate press
mechanisms_tried.result: worse (0/8): the thumb deflects instead of pushing

mechanisms_tried.name: in-air bimanual inject (tube in the left fist presses the rod top)
mechanisms_tried.result: 21.5 mm, 79 sustained steps on the first probe; but the 3.2 N reaction slides the barrel through the right fingers on other grasps, and squeezing the fingers to 1.7 rad ejects the barrel

mechanisms_tried.name: SUPPORTED bimanual dispense: tip rested on the plate, pipette uprighted by rotating the hand about the tip, tip re-centred, left fist brought up/over/down onto the rod top, closed loop on the plunger
mechanisms_tried.result: press reaches 20-29 mm on every attempt where the fist meets the rod; certified dispense (v5: 20 mm sustained 15 steps, finger-held, over the plate) on roughly half of the inject attempts; transport replays reach the plate on ~35 % of episode-conditions

mechanisms_tried.name: bimanual variants (2026-09-14 00:00-01:45): tube in the fist vertical/horizontal, palm-up back of hand, side approaches, up to 3 attempts
mechanisms_tried.result: the tube slides out of the fist under any load or motion along its axis in every orientation; palm-up hits the wrist yaw limit across the body; the palm-down fist/tube stalls 1.2-2 cm from the rod top (the tube comes in through the right hand) against a 1.5-2 cm tube-on-rod tolerance; 1 certified in ~10 attempts. Root causes fixed along the way and kept: point-transferred Jacobian for a pusher away from the wrist origin, hard-limit clamping (a soft-limit margin stalled the servo under gravity sag), prop restore of the plate only.

why_supported: the force path is fist -> rod -> spring -> barrel -> plate; the right grip carries no press load, so grip friction (the failure of the in-air inject) is irrelevant. The plate is a 12 x 8 x 4 cm kinematic block: a rigid, immovable support.
reset_side_effect_found: the upstream reset restores only the piston; restoring the tube popped it out of the closed left fist (tube-to-wrist 0.20-0.30 m instead of 0.16 m). RESTORED_PROPS is therefore ('pot',) only.
action_range_defect_found: the SFT normaliser gives the left-arm dims a 0.1-0.2 rad range (the demonstrations never move that arm); the primitive moves them by up to 2.2 rad (normalised -24..+19 against the +/-2.2 squash). The pressing policy trains against a widened, versioned statistics file that its checkpoint records (build_press_bc_buffer.py, NORM_STATS).
primitive: tools/g1_piston/make_press_demos.py VARIANTS='[{"name":"dispense","dispense":true}]': centre tip over the plate -> descend to contact (plate top + 5 mm push) -> upright (twist about the tip, < 3 deg) -> re-centre -> left fist up to rod top + 5 cm, over, down (limit-clamped damped-least-squares IK, ramped, 1.5 mm/step) -> inject (0.6 mm/step, pusher servoed over the rod top, right hand keeps the tip over the plate centre) until plunger >= 21.5 mm -> hold 0.6 s -> release 5 cm -> hold. Episodes kept only if v5 dispense certifies.

data.buffer: demo_buffer_v5_press (build_press_bc_buffer.py: certified synthetic + originals truncated at the plate chunk)

adopted_primitive.phases: centre tip over the plate (+2 cm x) -> descend to contact + 5 mm -> upright by a twist about the tip (< 3 deg, ~160 steps) -> re-centre -> descend: the hand slides down the barrel, the lateral servo keeps the pipette vertical, until the plunger reaches 21.5 mm (closed loop; 2-6 cm of descent) -> hold 0.6 s -> raise 5 cm -> hold
adopted_primitive.why_it_works_now: with the pipette vertical the rod top sits under the palm heel as the hand slides down; earlier palm presses crept and plateaued because the pipette hung 15-30 deg off vertical and uprighting by translation slid the tip off the plate
adopted_primitive.arms: right arm only (dims 7-13, inside the SFT normaliser range); the widened statistics for dims 0-6 are unnecessary for this primitive but harmless

bc_press_result.training: tools/g1_piston/train_bc.py on demo_buffer_v5_press (40 certified palm-press episodes + 15 originals truncated at the plate chunk; 1653 transitions; normaliser identical to the SFT file); final MSE 0.000691 (working BC: 0.001005)
bc_press_result.horizon_defect: the synthetic episodes are 30-44 chunks long (transport ~15 + primitive ~20) and the task has NO time-out termination, but every sweep ran EP_CHUNKS=23, the length of the human demonstrations. At 23 chunks the pressing policy scored dispense 0.00 in both v5 sweeps; at 40 chunks the same checkpoint scores dispense 0.16, press 0.08, one full success.
bc_press_result.next: second 40-chunk sweep and a paired 40-chunk baseline sweep (running); 40-chunk render; run 12 = GRPO under v5 from bc_press with 40-chunk episodes (chain_rl12.sh)
